citations.title: Enterprise AI for Document Management: FAQ - Doxis
excerpts: What types of AI models does Doxis use, and can I choose which model for which use case?

Doxis takes a "composable AI" approach: rather than depending on a single model, the platform allows a specific AI model to be connected to a given business process, and lets you measure how effective that combination is. If another model proves more effective or better suited to the need, it can be substituted easily, without rebuilding everything. This lets Doxis always rely on the most relevant model for a given use case, rather than "putting all its eggs in one basket."
How can I make sure my AI credits are being used the right way?

Thanks to Doxis' granular AI credit management, customers can define which teams, roles, or profiles use these credits, track their consumption, and redirect it to other teams if needed. This ensures optimized credit usage, aligned with workflow performance and the business value generated.
Can AI in Doxis perform tasks on behalf of users?

Yes, within clear limits that keep users in control. Through [Ask Doxi](https://www.doxis.com/en/ai-features/ask-doxi) , or through any AI assistant connected via the Doxis MCP server, users can ask questions in natural language. The AI then searches for and retrieves relevant documents, summarizes information, and answers questions based on the content the user is permitted to access. It works within the user's existing permissions, so it never exposes content beyond what that user could already see.
Do my users have to use the Doxis interface to interact with the platform in natural language?

No. From their browser, within DoxisCube, the AI assistant already enables natural-language interaction. But thanks to the MCP server offered by Doxis, the platform can also be connected to any AI assistant on the market (Copilot, Claude, Teams, etc.). This makes it possible to combine the analytical power of a large language model with the tools made available by the MCP server, so that every action available in Doxis can be triggered, securely and with full governance, from the AI assistants users already work with every day.
Who can use AI in Doxis: only end users?

No, Doxis AI is designed for three different profiles. End users and lines of business can create their own workflows without IT support, this is, in particular, the whole point of Doxis Business Studio, which allows workflows to be built in natural language, fully independent of IT. Doxis administrators / document management architects, meanwhile, can rely on AI to design an entire metadata and information architecture tailored to a new project or business team, somewhat as if the AI pre-structured a relevant folder tree before the team even begins working on it.
Where is my data stored, and who can access it?

Doxis offers several deployment models ( [cloud, on-premises & hybrid](https://www.doxis.com/en/business-platform/cloud-on-premises-hybrid) ) to meet the needs of every type of organization, including those with the strictest security requirements (defense sector included). In cloud mode, data can be hosted in our partners' data centers, with the option for the customer to choose the geographic storage region to meet their data sovereignty requirements.
Does Doxis integrate with my ERP / CRM / Microsoft 365 / SAP?

Yes. Doxis was designed to give organizations a holistic view by contextualizing all information related to their customers, projects, and cases. The platform connects to any ERP, CRM, or Microsoft 365 environment through certified integrations, with bidirectional data exchange: Doxis can both retrieve information from these applications and trigger actions or update data back in them (for example, a candidate status change in SuccessFactors can trigger a business workflow directly in Doxis).

Doxis offers dedicated, certified integrations for the platforms customers ask about most, including [SAP](https://www.doxis.com/en/sap-solutions) , [Microsoft Dynamics 365](https://www.doxis.com/en/solutions/microsoft/dms-for-dynamics) , [Microsoft Office 365](https://www.doxis.com/en/solutions/microsoft/dms-for-office-365) , [Salesforce](https://www.doxis.com/en/solutions/salesforce) , [Workday](https://www.doxis.com/en/solutions/dms-for-workday) , and [ServiceNow](https://www.doxis.com/en/solutions/dms-for-servicenow) . A full overview of supported systems is available on the [integrations page](https://www.doxis.com/en/solutions/business-connectors) .
Can Doxis handle our document volumes?

Yes. Doxis is recognized as a leader in document management, in large part thanks to its "metadata factory", the platform's foundational layer that structures and adds value to all information linked to documents. This architecture can process several hundred million documents per year, or even per day, for mission-critical needs. DHL Express demonstrates this ability to absorb very high volumes: with Doxis, it built the Global Imaging Archive, the world's largest commercial document archive, housing over 8.5 billion documents and growing by 130 million new documents every month. [Read the DHL Express case study](https://www.doxis.com/en/customer-stories/dhl-express-germany) .
Is AI enabled by default or opt-in? Can it be controlled by department?

Administrators decide how AI is used in Doxis. They can enable or disable specific AI capabilities for certain users, define access to certain types of information by role or profile, and manage all of this at the department level. This keeps AI usage aligned with your security and governance requirements. Administrators can also manage AI credits the same way, ensuring they are allocated to the teams where they generate the most business value.
Does the AI process our documents outside our environment?

The core Doxis platform for content and process management does not transfer any data outside an on-premises installation. When it comes to AI, many Doxis AI services rely on large language models, but these are typically privately hosted: the customer provides its own private LLM environment and configures Doxis to use it, so documents stay within infrastructure the customer controls. Data only leaves the customer's environment if cloud-based AI services are deliberately chosen and configured, and which service is used, and where that data is processed, depends on the use case and configuration.
How is AI access to our documents controlled and traced?

Yes. When an AI assistant connects to Doxis through the Doxis MCP server, the connection authenticates as a specific Doxis user and works strictly within that user's existing permissions. The AI can only access what that user is allowed to see, and every action is traceable to that user account. In Ask Doxi, each answer also shows the documents it was based on, so users can see where the information came from and check it.
Is there human review (human-in-the-loop) of the results produced by the AI?

Doxis embraces the human-in-the-loop principle, recognized as a key lever for improving model performance and achieving efficiency close to 99% on certain processes. The availability of this human control can vary by product: on some, it is a configurable setting; in other cases, particularly where data is sensitive or [classified](https://www.doxis.com/en/idp/document-classification) , different approaches can be adapted to the customer's needs.
How does Doxis manage the risk of AI hallucinations in document processing?

Hallucinations are a known risk of generative AI, so Doxis applies different safeguards depending on how AI is used. For document processing, such as classifying documents and extracting data, human-in-the-loop validation lets users review and correct results before they flow into downstream processes. For answers generated in Ask Doxi, responses are grounded in the customer's own documents using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and each answer shows the documents it was based on, so users can verify the source.

citations.title: SER Group Rebrands To 'Doxis' and Enhances Leadership to Reflect AI-First Focus as 'The Document Intelligence Company' - Doxis
excerpts: # SER Group Rebrands To 'Doxis' and Enhances Leadership to Reflect AI-First Focus as 'The Document Intelligence Company'

(January 19, 2026 - Bonn) SER Group today announced it has changed its brand name to “Doxis”, uniting the company under the same brand as its flagship Intelligent Content Automation platform and solutions. The rebrand coincides with the appointment of new senior leaders in sales and AI to accelerate the company’s commercial success and innovation as “The Document Intelligence Company”.

Rebranding the company as Doxis marks a decisive new chapter in its evolution as a leading provider of next-generation intelligent content automation software, capping 40 years of innovation and customer success with another year of profitable growth in 2025. While the company brand has changed, products and services maintain their existing names.

Dr. John Bates, CEO of Doxis, says, “Over five million users work with the [Doxis platform](https://www.doxis.com/en/business-platform/doxis-intelligent-content-automation) every day to get their work done more efficiently, compliantly and intelligently. In the past twelve months we welcomed three acquisitions to broaden the value and power of the platform for those customers. Now, united under the trusted Doxis brand and led by our popular mascot and AI assistant Doxi, we are excited to share our new brand and Document Intelligence vision with customers and partners.”
### A new era: Delivering Document Intelligence

As The Document Intelligence Company, Doxis delivers a full suite of solutions across the entire document lifecycle on a single, unified AI-first platform. “Where competitors offer fragmented point solutions, Doxis delivers true end-to-end document lifecycle automation and governance on one platform — deeply integrated with leading enterprise technologies such as SAP, Salesforce, and Microsoft,” says Bates.

This evolution builds on recent strategic investments, including acquisitions in [customer communication management](https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us/news-press/ser-group-acquires-metaforce) , [SAP document automation](https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us/news-press/ser-group-doubles-down-on-sap-document-automation-expertise-with-acquisition-of-afi-solutions-2) , and [intelligent document processing](https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us/news-press/ser-group-acquires-intelligent-document-processing-innovator-klippa) , which enable customers to replace siloed solutions with one consolidated platform that provides holistic, efficient control over information flows across the enterprise.
### New AI and Sales leaders drive next chapter of Doxis growth

To support the company’s global expansion and innovation as the business scales under the new Doxis brand, the company has further strengthened its leadership team with three senior Sales and AI appointments.

Yeelen Knegtering has been appointed Chief AI Officer of Doxis. As co-founder and CEO of IDP provider Klippa — acquired by Doxis in March 2025 — Knegtering will lead Doxis’ company-wide AI strategy. This includes AI implementation, ethics and governance, bridging technology and business objectives to drive innovation, efficiency, and new revenue opportunities for Doxis.

Andy Spence joins Doxis as Chief Revenue Officer. He is responsible for the global sales organization, including Solution Engineering and Revenue Operations. Spence brings extensive experience from both public and private equity-backed software companies. Most recently, he was Chief Sales Officer at Accelya and previously led EMEA North at Qlik.

Doxis also welcomes Jean Van Vuuren as Vice President of Sales EMEA. Van Vuuren has deep expertise in the enterprise content management (ECM) and intelligent document processing (IDP) markets, with over two decades of experience driving growth across healthcare and international markets.

basis.reasoning: The January 19, 2026 announcement names a new Chief AI Officer, Chief Revenue Officer, and VP of Sales EMEA; these appointments fall within the 12 months before November 9, 2026.

excerpts: # Doxis Summit 2026: Doxis Unveils Latest Document Intelligence Innovations
(June 17, 2026 - Bonn) Doxis, The Document Intelligence Company, unveiled a new generation of AI-powered Document Intelligence innovations at the Doxis Summit 2026.

* **Nestlé, [Eli Lilly](https://www.doxis.com/en/medialibrary/eli-lilly-processes-over-50-000-invoices-per-month) , BSHG (Bosch Group)** and other leading global brands shared real-world success stories of [AI-powered content automation](https://www.doxis.com/en/business-platform/content-understanding) and digital transformation with [Doxis](https://www.doxis.com/en/business-platform/doxis-intelligent-content-automation)

* At largest Summit to date, Doxis unveiled next-generation AI innovations including **Ask Doxi, Agent Manager** and **enhanced Superhuman Search** , enabling organizations to turn enterprise knowledge into trusted answers, governed [automation](https://www.doxis.com/en/glossary/automation) and business value

* Keynote speakers **Doxis CEO Dr. John Bates, IDC Senior Research Manager Amy Machado** and **tech futurist Peter Hinssen** reinforced that enterprise AI only creates business value when it runs on trusted, governed and connected [document intelligence](https://www.doxis.com/en/business-platform/doxis-aidp)

Doxis, The Document Intelligence Company, unveiled a new generation of AI-powered Document Intelligence innovations at the Doxis Summit 2026, helping organizations unlock greater value from enterprise content while maintaining the trust, governance and control required for AI success. More than 600 customers, partners and industry experts from around the world attended the company's largest-ever Summit in Munich on May 20 and 21.

The Summit featured customer-led sessions from organizations including Nestlé, Eli Lilly, BSHG (Bosch Group), Kerry, [SEW-EURODRIVE](https://www.doxis.com/en/medialibrary/sew-eurodrive-a-smart-motor-for-documents) and more, who presented how they are streamlining complex processes, improving [compliance](https://www.doxis.com/en/glossary/what-is-compliance-management) , accelerating decision-making and unlocking greater value from enterprise information with the Doxis Intelligent Content Automation platform.

Nestlé shared how it is building a trusted foundation for governance, compliance and AI innovation. The company recently completed a massive global migration project, consolidating 30 TB of enterprise content, 20 million metadata records, 15 applications and 40,000 users onto a single governed platform. The initiative provides the scale, security and control needed to support AI innovation across Nestlé's global operations, which span 185 countries and more than 270,000 employees.
**Doxis announces innovations to help organizations operationalize AI**
The Summit also provided attendees a first look at the latest Doxis innovations designed to help organizations operationalize AI safely and effectively, including:

* **Ask Doxi** – A new context-aware AI assistant that helps users move from searching to understanding, enabling natural language access to enterprise content with fully traceable answers and source references.

* **Agent Manager** – New capabilities for creating and governing enterprise [AI agents](https://www.doxis.com/en/blog/agentic-ai) , giving organizations greater visibility, control and trust as AI takes on more autonomous tasks.

* **Enhanced Superhuman Search features** – Designed to improve search experience, combining metadata, full-text, vector and AI-powered search technologies to deliver faster, more accurate and trustworthy answers across enterprise information.

Senior VP of Product Douglas Cardoso also previewed the Doxis roadmap, including new capabilities for intelligent communications, [Workday](https://www.doxis.com/en/solutions/dms-for-workday) and [SAP integrations](https://www.doxis.com/en/sap-solutions) , insurance [workflows](https://www.doxis.com/en/automate-workflows) , automated metadata enrichment and AI-powered knowledge discovery across enterprise content.
**Building trust and business value in an AI-driven world**

Trust in an AI-driven world was a central theme throughout the event. In his opening keynote, Doxis CEO Dr. John Bates explored the opportunities and risks of the current AI revolution, arguing that organizations need safeguards that prevent hallucinations, enforce governance and ensure predictable outcomes in mission-critical processes.

"AI is creating enormous opportunities for organizations, but in the document world, trust is everything," said Bates. "The winners won't be those who simply adopt AI the fastest. They'll be the organizations that combine innovation with governance, context and control. That's what Document Intelligence delivers."

Technology futurist Peter Hinssen and IDC Senior Research Manager Amy Machado explored both the opportunities and challenges of enterprise AI adoption. While Hinssen highlighted the unprecedented pace of AI-driven change and the need for organizations to adapt faster than ever, Machado emphasized that AI success ultimately depends on a strong content foundation.

Together, their keynotes reinforced a key message of the event: organizations that classify, govern and connect information effectively will be best positioned to turn AI investments into measurable business value.
**Largest Doxis Summit to date follows year of transformative growth**
As the largest Doxis Summit to date, the 2026 edition reflected the growing momentum behind Document Intelligence and the increasing importance of trusted AI across enterprise operations.

Following a transformative year that saw the company [rebrand as Doxis](https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us/news-press/ser-group-rebrands-to-doxis) and integrate [Klippa](https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us/news-press/ser-group-acquires-intelligent-document-processing-innovator-klippa) , [AFI Solutions](https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us/news-press/ser-group-doubles-down-on-sap-document-automation-expertise-with-acquisition-of-afi-solutions-2) and [Metaforce](https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us/news-press/ser-group-acquires-metaforce) into its AI-first platform, the Summit underscored Doxis' positioning as The Document Intelligence Company. As an [IDC](https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us/news-press/ser-group-named-leader-idc-marketscape-report-2024) \- and [Gartner®-recognized Leader](https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us/news-press/doxis-named-a-leader-in-gartner-magic-quadrant-for-document-management-2026) , Doxis is committed to helping organizations turn content chaos into insight, automate work and maximize their return on information.
Please don't hesitate to contact us for press inquiries via email or phone.
